_meta.description: Tier 3: Btw-compensatiefonds (BCF) VAT compensation claims. Adds one BcfClaim schema with a draft → submitted → accepted → settled lifecycle for the quarterly recovery of non-recoverable VAT by Dutch public bodies (gemeenten, waterschappen). The compensable-VAT total and per-account breakdown are computed server-side by OCA\Shillinq\Service\BcfClaimService from existing GLLine + GLTransaction + BbvAccountMapping data via the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (findAll), weighting each compensable account by its BbvAccountMapping.compensablePercentage; the x-openregister-aggregations block documents the equivalent declarative shape. The draft → submitted transition is gated by OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\BcfClaimGuard:canSubmit (non-empty claim + closed quarter). BbvAccountMapping already carries the bcfCompensable + compensablePercentage flags from add-shillinq-bookkeeping-operations; this fragment also re-asserts their descriptions for completeness. Seed objects provide four worked example claims across the lifecycle states for two municipal administrations per design.md.

BcfClaim.title: BCF VAT Compensation Claim
BcfClaim.description: A quarterly Btw-compensatiefonds (BCF) claim through which a Dutch public body recovers non-recoverable VAT. The compensable total and per-account breakdown are computed server-side by BcfClaimService from the general ledger; operators never author the derived figures directly. The claim follows a draft → submitted → accepted → settled lifecycle.

claimQuarter.description: Quarter identifier this claim covers (FK to the GL fiscal period; aligns with T2 period boundaries). Forward-only: must be ≥ install date.
claimQuarter.title: Claim Quarter

administrationId.description: Administration this claim belongs to (FK to Administration). A public body: gemeente or waterschap. Single administration per claim.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

totalCompensableAmount.description: Total compensable VAT for the quarter in EUR. Derived, read-only: computed by BcfClaimService as the sum of each compensable account's VAT weighted by BbvAccountMapping.compensablePercentage. Frozen at submission.
totalCompensableAmount.title: Total Compensable Amount

breakdown.description: Per-account compensable-VAT breakdown. Derived, read-only: one row per compensable account that contributed to the quarter total. Frozen at submission.

accountNumber.description: RGS general-ledger account code (FK to Account.accountNumber).
accountNumber.title: Account Number

amount.description: VAT amount posted to this account in the quarter, before weighting.
amount.title: Amount

compensablePercentage.description: Weighting applied to this account (from BbvAccountMapping.compensablePercentage).
compensablePercentage.title: Compensable Percentage

compensableAmount.description: Weighted compensable VAT for this account = amount × compensablePercentage / 100.
compensableAmount.title: Compensable Amount

breakdown.title: Breakdown

state.description: Claim lifecycle state. Driven by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine; never freely edited by operators.
state.title: State

submittedOn.description: Timestamp when the claim was submitted to Belastingdienst via DigiKoppeling.
submittedOn.title: Submitted On

acceptedOn.description: Timestamp when Belastingdienst accepted the claim (external actor).
acceptedOn.title: Accepted On

settledOn.description: Timestamp when Belastingdienst settled the payment, set from the settlement webhook.
settledOn.title: Settled On

settledAmount.description: Amount settled by Belastingdienst in EUR, recorded from the settlement webhook.
settledAmount.title: Settled Amount

attachmentUri.description: Reference to uploaded supporting documents (PDFs, spreadsheets) for the claim.
attachmentUri.title: Attachment URI

notes.description: Operator notes; not transmitted to Belastingdienst.
notes.title: Notes

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Operator is preparing the claim; the compensable breakdown recalculates from the GL. Editable.

submitted.label: Ingediend
submitted.description: Submitted to Belastingdienst via DigiKoppeling; figures are frozen.

settled.label: Afgewikkeld
settled.description: Belastingdienst settled the payment; set from the settlement webhook.

submit.label: Indienen bij Belastingdienst
submit.description: Submit the claim. Requires a non-empty compensable total (> 0) and a closed claim quarter (period-lock from T2). The total is recomputed server-side from the GL.

accept.label: Geaccepteerd door Belastingdienst
accept.description: Belastingdienst accepts the claim (external actor; no local guard).

settle.label: Afgewikkeld door Belastingdienst
settle.description: Belastingdienst settles the payment, triggered by the settlement webhook. No local guard; the manual fallback transitions accepted → settled when the webhook is lost.

bcf-claim-submit-approval.description: Approval chain that gates the BcfClaim draft → submitted transition. The transition runs through OpenRegister's approval-workflow primitive: a single approver with the role bcf-administrator must approve within 7 days (configurable). On approval the claim advances to submitted and is queued for the next quarterly digikoppeling-bcf ScheduledWorkflow run; on rejection the claim stays draft and the operator is notified with the rejection comment. Declarative metadata only: OR materialises the actual approval task; this app ships no PHP approval-chain implementation.

bcf-claim-settled.description: Settlement webhook routing. OR's generic webhook handler routes inbound CloudEvents of type nl.conduction.bcf-claim-settled to BcfClaim and applies the settle transition. The event payload is { type, objectId, data: { state: 'settled', settledAmount, settledDate } }. The handler verifies the OpenConnector signature, looks the BcfClaim up by objectId (administration scope enforced via the audit-trail context), sets state=settled + settledOn=settledDate + settledAmount=settledAmount, and records the webhook event in the audit trail (source=webhook, event-id, timestamp, payload-hash). Lost webhooks do not block: the operator can transition accepted → settled manually via the detail page as a fallback.

compensableVatBreakdown.description: Declarative shape of the per-account compensable-VAT roll-up BcfClaimService computes. Groups GLLine by accountNumber within an administration + claimQuarter, sums the debit-side VAT amounts, joins BbvAccountMapping to keep only bcfCompensable accounts, and weights each by compensablePercentage / 100. The weighted sum is totalCompensableAmount and the rows are breakdown. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the cross-schema weighted join, BcfClaimService computes the same result in PHP from the real ObjectService API.

bcfCompensable.description: Whether VAT posted to this account is eligible for BCF compensation. Default false: an account is only claimed when explicitly marked compensable.
bcfCompensable.title: Bcf Compensable

compensablePercentage.description: Weighting (0-100) for mixed-use accounts: the share of this account's VAT that is compensable. 100 for a fully compensable account, lower for a mixed public/commercial facility.
compensablePercentage.title: Compensable Percentage

bcf-claim-amsterdam-2025q1.notes: Q1 2025 — publieke dienstverlening, gemengd gebruik nutsvoorziening 50%.

bcf-claim-amsterdam-2025q2.notes: Q2 2025 — geaccepteerd, in afwachting van afwikkeling.

bcf-claim-utrecht-2025q3.notes: Q3 2025 — concept; nog geen compensabele posten geboekt.
